name: Momentum Breakout
description: High relative volume stocks near 52-week highs with bullish technical breakouts. Targets stocks in confirmed uptrends with accelerating momentum and institutional volume. Win rate target: 60-65%.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks strong price momentum analyst upgrades accelerating earnings growth high relative volume mid-to-large cap making new highs confirmed uptrend strong sector tailwinds institutional accumulation
ta_focus: 52-week high breakout with volume confirmation, EMA 9 > 21 > 50 > 200 full bullish stack, ADX > 25 trend strength, Supertrend green, RSI 55-70 momentum zone, MACD positive histogram expanding
trading_style: Day to swing trader, 2-5 day holds

name: EMA 50/200 Golden Cross Swing
description: Classic golden cross (EMA 50 crossing above EMA 200) swing strategy with MACD momentum confirmation and ADX trend strength filter. One of the most backtested high-win-rate swing setups with 60-70% historical win rates on daily charts.
screening_prompt: TSX stocks with recent EMA 50 crossing above EMA 200 golden cross pattern strong uptrend formation improving fundamentals analyst upgrades solid earnings history mid-to-large cap quality businesses entering new uptrend phase
ta_focus: EMA 50 above EMA 200 golden cross confirmed, price above both EMAs, ADX > 25 confirming trend strength, RSI 50-70 bullish zone, MACD above zero line with positive histogram, Bollinger Bands expanding on breakout, volume above average on up-days
trading_style: Swing trader, 1-4 week holds, trend following

name: EMA 21 Pullback Swing
description: Trend continuation strategy buying pullbacks to the 21 EMA in a confirmed uptrend (price above EMA 50 and 200). High-probability setup with 62-68% win rates targeting stocks with strong trends that dip to the 21 EMA on low volume before resuming.
screening_prompt: TSX stocks in confirmed uptrend above 50 and 200 EMA pulling back to 21 EMA support on light volume healthy consolidation strong momentum sector leaders analyst buy ratings recent higher lows pattern
ta_focus: Price above EMA 50 and 200 uptrend confirmed, pullback touching or near 21 EMA on declining volume, RSI reset to 40-55 range from overbought without breaking below 40, MACD still above zero, Williams %R showing mild oversold -50 to -65 for entry timing, ADX above 20 confirming trend intact, bounce candle with volume expansion

name: Bollinger Band Squeeze Breakout Swing
description: Targets Bollinger Band squeeze setups (bands contracting to multi-week lows) followed by explosive breakout with volume confirmation. High-win-rate swing setup when breakout direction is confirmed by MACD and ADX trend strength.
screening_prompt: TSX stocks consolidating tightly near recent highs low volatility squeeze pattern institutional accumulation strong fundamentals sector momentum pending catalyst breakout candidates coiling for next move
ta_focus: Bollinger Band width at 20-day minimum squeeze, price coiling inside tight range, ADX below 20 in squeeze phase then rising above 25 on breakout, MACD histogram crossing zero, Supertrend flipping green on breakout candle, volume 1.5x+ average on breakout, RSI breaking above 55 on breakout day
trading_style: Swing trader, 5-15 day holds targeting band expansion

name: Mean Reversion
description: Oversold quality stocks near support levels primed for bounce. Uses RSI divergence, Bollinger Band lower touch, and Supertrend flip for high-confidence entries. Win rate target: 65-70% on 3-7 day holds.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks recently sold off 15-30% past month strong fundamentals analysts maintain buy ratings insider buying during decline oversold bounce candidates with solid financials quality scores Piotroski 5+ Altman Z safe zone
ta_focus: RSI < 35 with bullish divergence vs price, Bollinger Band lower band touch or pierce with reversal candle, Supertrend about to flip green, Williams %R below -80 oversold, MACD histogram reducing on downside showing seller exhaustion, EMA 200 acting as support, volume spike on reversal day confirming buyers stepping in

name: Value Accumulation
description: Undervalued names with insider buying and strong fundamentals. Long-term accumulation at discount to intrinsic value with Piotroski 6+ and Altman Z safe-zone confirmation. Win rate target: 65%+ on 4-8 week timeframe.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks undervalued low P/E P/B discount to sector peers recent insider buying growing free cash flow strong balance sheet analyst buy ratings quality businesses at fair prices Piotroski score 6+
ta_focus: Accumulation zones near EMA 200 or multi-month support, RSI reset below 45 from oversold bounce, MACD bullish divergence, Bollinger Bands lower band touch with reversal candle, ADX below 20 in base then rising on entry, volume expansion on green days vs red days accumulation signature

name: Earnings Play
description: Stocks reporting earnings within 2 weeks with high beat rate and pre-earnings technical strength. Highest sentiment weighting of all strategies to capture analyst revisions and target upgrades before the catalyst.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks reporting earnings next 2 weeks strong earnings beat history upward estimate revisions analyst attention meaningful catalyst potential confirmed reporting date positive sector trends
ta_focus: Pre-earnings Bollinger Band squeeze consolidation, price above EMA 50 and 200, ADX rising indicating building momentum, RSI 50-65 pre-catalyst coiling, MACD positive bias, volume decreasing during consolidation coiling, ATR expanding as earnings approach indicating IV pickup

name: Intraday Scalp
description: Short-term momentum scalps on 15-minute charts upgraded with Supertrend direction filter and ADX chop filter. Targets liquid TSX large-caps in play with confirmed catalyst. Win rate target: 60-65%.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks in play today breaking news earnings releases analyst upgrades sector catalysts liquid large-cap mid-cap high relative volume active day trading names with confirmed price movement gap-up or gap-down candidates
ta_focus: VWAP holds on 15m with EMA 9/21 bullish stack, Supertrend green confirming intraday bias, ADX > 20 confirming directional move not chop, RSI 50-65 for longs or 35-50 for shorts, MACD positive histogram on 15m, volume 2x+ average on entry candle, ATR-based stop sizing
trading_style: Intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds

name: EMA Stack Momentum Intraday
description: 9/21/50 EMA stack with VWAP confirmation for intraday momentum entries on trending stocks. All three EMAs must be in bullish order above VWAP — this full-stack alignment is the primary quality filter elevating win rate to 60-65%.
screening_prompt: TSX NASDAQ NYSE stocks in play today high relative volume morning momentum breaking out above pre-market highs VWAP hold confirmed bullish EMA alignment large-cap mid-cap liquid names with strong sector tailwinds
ta_focus: 9/21/50 EMA bullish stack alignment above VWAP, Supertrend green, RSI 50-70 momentum zone, MACD histogram expanding, high-volume breakout candles, Williams %R not yet overbought above -20 on entry

name: Opening Range Breakout
description: Trades breakouts above/below the first 30-minute opening range with volume surge confirmation. Proven intraday edge with 60%+ win rates when price breaks cleanly above ORH or below ORL with 2.5x+ relative volume.
screening_prompt: TSX NYSE NASDAQ stocks with catalysts today earnings analyst upgrades sector news pre-market volume spikes liquid stocks with clean 30-minute opening range formation high beta names with directional momentum
ta_focus: 30-minute opening range high/low levels as key breakout zones, breakout above ORH with volume 2x average, Supertrend direction matches breakout side, VWAP as secondary trend filter, RSI not overbought on breakout candle ideally 55-68, ATR-based stop placed below ORH level

name: VWAP Reversal Scalp
description: High-precision VWAP bounce and rejection scalp with Supertrend direction filter and Williams %R for overbought/oversold timing. Targets liquid large-caps with 60-65% win rate using strict VWAP hold/reject confirmation rules.
screening_prompt: TSX large-cap stocks with clean VWAP levels today high daily volume market leaders in strong sectors liquid names above or below VWAP with clear trend direction confirmed institutional activity
ta_focus: VWAP pullback bounce long or VWAP rejection short, Supertrend confirms direction, Williams %R oversold below -80 for longs or overbought above -20 for shorts, green or red confirmation candle at VWAP with decreasing volume on pullback, MACD histogram positive or negative bias aligns with trade direction

name: Crypto Swing
description: Swing trade crypto assets with strong momentum and on-chain metrics. Full EMA 9/21/50/200 stack with Supertrend and Bollinger Bands for AI chart reading. 3-month momentum filter added to avoid dead assets.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies strong momentum growing on-chain activity active addresses TVL growth developer activity protocol upgrades social buzz top 100 market cap EMA golden cross forming
ta_focus: EMA 50/200 golden cross or bullish stack, Supertrend green on daily, RSI 50-70 momentum zone, MACD histogram positive and expanding, Bollinger Bands widening on breakout, volume above 20-day average on up days, ATR expanding indicating trend acceleration

name: Crypto Intraday Scalp
description: Short-term crypto scalps on 15-minute charts with VWAP and Supertrend for direction, Williams %R for entry timing. Targets top-50 crypto with deep liquidity and confirmed intraday momentum.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies trending today high 24-hour volume breaking news token unlocks exchange listings viral social activity top 50 market cap deep liquidity major exchanges intraday momentum confirmed
ta_focus: VWAP holds on 15m chart with Supertrend green, Williams %R oversold bounce below -75 for long entries, RSI 45-65 momentum continuation zone, EMA 9 > 21 bullish micro-stack, MACD positive histogram on 15m, volume surge 2x+ on entry candle, ATR-based stops
trading_style: Crypto intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds
